headlines.title: U.S. military intentionally allowing some Iranian projectiles through defenses
headlines.description: Two senior U.S. officials tell NBC News that military commanders are allowing some Iranian missiles and attack drones to get through air defenses amid an effort to preserve the Pentagon’s shrinking supply of missiles to shoot them down. NBC News’ Courtney Kube reports.

headlines.title: Trump touts his accomplishments and relationship with the press at Correspondents' Dinner
headlines.description: President Trump gave lengthy speech at the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner, where he insulted his political rivals and touted his accomplishments and relationship with the press.

headlines.title: Trump orders signage warning visitors of ‘inaccurate information’ at Smithsonian
headlines.description: While he continues to seek control of the exhibits inside the Smithsonian Institution’s museums, President Donald Trump is trying a new tactic in the front yard.

headlines.title: Trump administration concedes that it canceled research grants in blue states
headlines.description: The Trump administration admitted that it terminated nearly 300 federal research grants “solely because” the projects were connected to states that voted against Trump in 2024

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: LeBron James announces he will join the Philadelphia 76ers
headlines.description: One of the NBA’s top talents, LeBron James, announced he plans to end his legendary career with the Philadelphia 76ers. In a social media post, James wrote “I believe I can help make the Philadelphia 76ers a championship team.” NBC News’ Sam Brock reports.

headlines.title: Text messages show teen whom singer D4vd is accused of killing had an abortion
headlines.description: LOS ANGELES — Celeste Rivas Hernandez, the teen whom singer D4vd is accused of killing, had an abortion during their relationship, text messages shown in court on Friday stated.

headlines.title: Iran war and Trump tariffs fuel higher gas prices and renewed inflation risks
headlines.description: The affordability crisis is revving up again. The war in Iran and Trump’s tariffs are pushing prices up and raising fears of renewed inflation.

headlines.title: Bags in vehicle of man fatally shot by ICE did not contain drugs, Texas DA says
headlines.description: HOUSTON — A substance investigators found in a van driven by a man fatally shot by ICE earlier this month was not an illegal narcotic, the Harris County District Attorney’s office said Friday.
